notes.title: We have some exciting news… Medievaly: Battle Simulator release date is here!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="ZdkKUiw2mS0;full"][/previewyoutube]📣 Big News - We’re thrilled to announce that Medievaly: Battle Simulator will officially launch on July 16th, 2025!


Get ready for an epic blend of real-time strategy and battle simulation where you'll command your troops to attack enemy castles, defend your own, and protect your farmers to gather gold. Build sieges, outsmart enemy tactics, and lead your army to victory across a variety of vibrant, beautifully colorful landscapes.


⚔️ Real-Time Strategy Meets Simulated Battles:
Deploy troops with precision, defend your stronghold, and outsmart your enemies using real-time tactics. Every unit placement and decision matters—use your mind to dominate the battlefield! Set up defenses, expand infrastructure, then send out your men-at-arms to valiantly die under your banner in unpredictable, occasionally chaotic battles.


🧱 Sandbox Mode with Custom Rules
Create your own battles with full control! Choose from 3 game modes:

• Castle Siege – Destroy the enemy's castle.

• Time Survival – Hold out until reinforcements arrive.

• Kill Count – First to eliminate 100 troops wins.

Select your terrain and craft your own war scenarios!


🎨 A Colorful Blend of Strategy and Simulation
Experience a vibrant, visually rich world where real-time strategy meets dynamic battle simulation. Watch your tactics unfold in stunning, stylized environments.


🔊 Prepare for battle — Join us at launch
Don't forget to wishlist the game on steam here and join our small, but strong community over on discord here. You can also follow us on Twitter here. We are beyond excited to show you what we have crafted. 



See you at launch day!

- Steelkrill Studio
